intent.raw: Run 3 subagents to produce a data-grounded inventory of implementation/domainspec, classifying each item for the domainspec->arcanum wedge lift. Decision Q1 (recorded): domainspec stays private; only the free wedge is exported to public arcanum. 'Going public' means exporting to arcanum only what arcanum will actually use.
intent.objective: Produce one merged, evidence-grounded inventory that classifies every domainspec subsystem as wedge (export to public arcanum), moat (stay private), or runtime (stay private), with reason and decision-support fields, so the open seam and parity decisions are made from data instead of assumption. This is evidence, not a migration and not a promotion.
intent.operator_sentence: Inventory first, decide second: classify domainspec by the open-core boundary, export only the wedge arcanum will use, record public/private + reason + parity + collision + coupling for each item.

steps.name: Frame the boundary and partition the repo into 3 non-overlapping scopes
stop_conditions: Stop if a scope overlaps another partition; each path belongs to exactly one agent.

steps.name: Three sibling agents inventory one partition each
steps.join_policy: union-by-path; on duplicate path keep higher-confidence row and record the conflict
stop_conditions: Stop a row at needs-decision rather than guessing when the wedge/moat seam runs through one artifact.
Never mark a moat or runtime item as export.

steps.name: Merge partials into one classified inventory with seam references and conflicts
stop_conditions: Stop at classification; do not promote any item into arcanum or mutate domainspec.

gates.rule: Every row must carry a reason grounded in a file or a COMMERCIALIZATION-SYNTHESIS section, plus a confidence value.
No moat or runtime item may carry disposition=export. Lean attestation half, CyberAlchemy engine, Craft metering, enforcement runtime, attestation product, Golden Quill/Tilth stay private.
Inventory is evidence only. It does not promote inventory, ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell knowledge, and does not move content.

stop_conditions: Stop before any file is moved into arcanum; this dispatch only classifies.
Stop and mark needs-decision rather than resolve a seam the user owns (Lean, host trees, Craft, constitution, definitions split).

subagent_strategy.trigger: Repo too large for one context; classification needs parallel coverage of disjoint subsystems with one shared schema.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Three role-bound siblings cover disjoint partitions so coverage is complete and rows are comparable; the seam decisions need breadth, not depth-in-one-area.
subagent_strategy.context: domainspec spans knowledge/governance, sigils/tools/Craft, and runtime/spec-test/Lean; the wedge/moat seam runs through definitions, Craft, constitution, and Lean.

roles.purpose: Inventory taxonomy, relationships, definitions, constitution/axioms, governance-attenuation, vault constitutions
Inventory the five host skill trees, tools/ validators+generators, code-tag extraction, Craft ledger, .arcanum/, and run the arcanum parity check
Inventory backend/apps/infra/implementation runtime, TEST-PIPELINE.md spec->test surface, and the Lean formalization

subagent_strategy.join_policy: union-by-path; orchestrator synthesizes in s03 and records conflicts
subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run 3 read-only inventory subagents over disjoint domainspec partitions? (approved by operator in-session)
receipt_requirements: inventory rows in the shared schema
list of unknowns or needs-decision items
parity findings vs arcanum where checked

agents.residue: vault/discovery and full constitution bodies not deep-read; confidence-levels.md flagged for closer pass
framework/observability vs public observability-setup needs a diff; experiment-harness local extraction divergence unknown
Lean lives in umbrella-root sibling submodule domainspec-lean-formalization, not inside implementation/domainspec; deterministic test-derivation-engine refutes R1
